title: (BIG ver.) Bye Bye, Pumpkin Blur!
description: Same as "Bye Bye, Pumpkin Blur," but BIGGER. Removes the default pumpkin blur texture and replaces it with the text "PUMPKIN" in the bottom left of your screen.
body:
## BIG VERSION - Bye Bye, Pumpkin Blur!

This pack removes the default pumpkin blur seen in game when wearing a carved pumpkin, and **<u>replaces it with the text "PUMPKIN"</u>** in the bottom left corner of the screen.\
\
This allows you to still have an indicator that you are wearing a carved pumpkin, but without the mess that the original texture creates.

### Text too big? Try the smaller version [here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bye-bye-pumpkin-blur)!

---
